pages.title: Pluto
pages.description: Dwarf planet in the outer Solar System
pages.snippet: In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) adopted a formal definition of planet. Pluto does not clear the neighborhood around its orbit, so it was reclassified as a dwarf planet.

pages.title: IAU definition of planet
pages.snippet: The definition adopted on 24 August 2006 states that a planet must orbit the Sun, be rounded by its own gravity, and have cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit.

pages.title: Dwarf planet
pages.description: Small planetary-mass object in direct orbit around the Sun
pages.snippet: A dwarf planet is a small planetary-mass object in direct orbit around the Sun, smaller than the eight classical planets but still a world in its own right.
